common_name_source: Entomological Society of America Common Names of Insects Database
source_file_label: Filename 7-2-26; internal heading Updated 3/4/25, retained as supplied.
match_rule: Exact resolved taxon name first, then exact parent species; otherwise exact ESA match to a binomial alias from the approved GBIF/COL XR crosswalk or explicit user synonym. Subspecies-only names are not generalized to the parent species. No fuzzy, genus or family name transfer. Multiple ESA names retained with semicolons. No source match leaves proposed_common_name blank.
coverage_note: ESA only for this version; BugGuide was not used. A blank means no match in this downloaded ESA list, not proof that no common name exists.
matching_service_provenance: All prior scientific-name match columns, original names, statuses, confidence, identifiers, request URLs and diagnostics are preserved. Full API responses remain cached locally.
